post: just adopted the sweetest little rescue cat today. she was hiding under the sofa for the first few hours but she finally came out to eat some treats from my hand. im so happy right now, ive wanted a pet for ages.
took my dog to the beach for the first time today. he absolutely lost his mind at the waves lol. we ran around for like two hours and now he's snoring so loud on the rug. best weekend in a while tbh.

got a new aquarium setup going and the plants are finally starting to take root. added a few cherry shrimp today and they look amazing against the green. such a relaxing hobby to just sit and watch them swim around.
my golden retriever finally learned how to catch a frisbee in mid air! we've been practicing for weeks and he finally nailed it today at the park. totally made my whole week, hes such a good boy.

woke up to my cat purring directly in my ear. normally it's annoying but today it was just really sweet. she curled up next to my pillow and we just chilled for an extra hour before getting out of bed.

tried baking sourdough bread for the first time and it actually didn't turn out like a brick! the crust is super crispy and the inside is fluffy. currently eating half the loaf with just butter, absolutely zero regrets.

finally nailed that homemade ramen recipe ive been experimenting with. the broth took literally 12 hours to simmer but oh man it was worth it. gonna invite some friends over this weekend to make them try it.

went to the farmers market this morning and got a massive haul of fresh veggies and strawberries. they taste so much better than the grocery store stuff. making a huge summer salad tonight for dinner and cant wait.

found a tiny authentic mexican place near my new apartment and just had the best tacos of my life. three al pastor tacos for like six bucks, and the green salsa was incredibly good. definitely my new regular spot.

spent the whole afternoon meal prepping for the week and feeling so productive. made huge batches of roasted veggies, chicken, and quinoa. future me is going to be so happy when i don't have to cook after work.

finally beat the final boss in elden ring after being stuck for literally three days. my hands are still shaking a bit lol. such an incredible game, probably going to start a new playthrough immediately.

started playing stardew valley again and im completely hooked just like the first time. just spent four hours arranging my little farm and making everything look pretty. it's so cozy and exactly what i needed to destress.

got my hands on the new zelda game and haven't left the couch all day. the world is so beautiful and exploring feels so rewarding. currently just wandering around looking for shrines and enjoying the scenery.
played some mario kart with my siblings tonight and we were laughing so hard my stomach hurts. I managed to dodge a blue shell for the first time ever and they lost their minds. good times.

upgraded my pc setup today with a new monitor and the colors look so insanely good. booting up cyberbunk just to see the neon lights and it looks like a totally different game. super hyped for my gaming sessions now.
the weather today is absolutely flawless. it's like 70 degrees, sunny with a slight breeze. opened all the windows in the house and just enjoying the fresh air while drinking some iced tea.
went for a hike this morning and reached the summit just as the fog was clearing up. the view over the valley was stunning. definitely going to make this trail a regular part of my weekend routine.

sitting on my porch watching a pretty intense thunderstorm roll in. the lightning is amazing and the sound of the rain is so incredibly relaxing. making myself a cup of hot chocolate and just enjoying the show.
took a walk through the botanical gardens today. all the spring flowers are in full bloom and it smells amazing everywhere you go. took way too many photos of tulips but i don't even care.
first snow of the year! everything is covered in a thick layer of white and it looks so peaceful outside. staying indoors wrapped in a blanket today, perfect excuse to do absolutely nothing.

had coffee with an old friend i haven't seen in over two years. we literally just picked up right where we left off like no time had passed. so nice to reconnect and just talk about life for a few hours.
my mom came over today and helped me reorganize my kitchen. we ended up finding some old photos and spent an hour just laughing at my awful haircuts from middle school. really nice afternoon overall.

went to a local trivia night with a few coworkers and we actually ended up winning second place! mostly thanks to my weirdly specific knowledge of 80s movies. definitely going back next week to try for first.
hosted a small board game night at my place. we played catan and things got extremely competitive in the best way possible. ordered way too much pizza but everybody left happy.
my sister just called to tell me she got the promotion she's been working so hard for! im so incredibly proud of her, taking her out for celebratory drinks this weekend to celebrate properly.
finally finished crocheting the blanket i've been working on for six months! it's massive and the colors look so good together. wrapping myself up in it right now and feeling very accomplished.
spent the evening painting and listening to some jazz. i am not a good artist by any means but mixing the colors and just putting paint on canvas is so therapeutic. just really enjoying the process.
started learning how to play the acoustic guitar a few weeks ago and today i finally played a full song without messing up the chords! my fingers hurt so much but im super happy about the progress.

restoring this old wooden dresser i found at a thrift store. just finished sanding it down and applying the first coat of stain. it's already looking a hundred times better, so satisfying to see the wood grain pop.
getting back into journaling lately and it's been really good for my mind. just dumping all my thoughts on paper before bed helps me sleep so much better. highly recommend trying it if you haven't.
just finished reading a really amazing fantasy book and im kind of sitting here staring at the wall processing the ending. it was so incredibly good, i cant wait to start the sequel tomorrow.

started watching that new mystery show everyone's been talking about and im completely hooked. the plot twists are actually unpredictable. three episodes in and im forcing myself to go to bed instead of bingeing the whole thing.
went to the movies by myself today for a matinee showing. got a massive tub of popcorn and just enjoyed the peace and quiet. honestly solo movie trips are wildly underrated.
rereading harry potter for like the tenth time. it just feels like coming back home, you know? wrapped up in my favorite hoodie on the couch with a cup of tea. perfect lazy sunday vibes.
found an old sitcom from the 90s on streaming that i completely forgot about. the jokes are a bit dated but it hits right in the nostalgia. been chuckling at it all evening.
finished all my big projects at work by noon today. my boss told me to just log off early and enjoy the afternoon. currently sitting on the patio enjoying the unexpected free time!
got my final grades back for the semester and i somehow managed an A in stats! i literally thought i failed the final exam. so relieved, now i can actually relax and enjoy the summer break.

had a really great meeting at work today where my ideas actually got listened to and implemented. feels really good to be valued by the team. treating myself to some fancy takeout tonight to celebrate a good day.
cleared out my inbox completely. zero unread emails. it's a minor thing but seeing that empty folder brings me a ridiculous amount of joy. starting the weekend with a clean slate feels awesome.

today was just one of those really smooth days where everything goes right. hit all the green lights on the commute, grabbed a great coffee, got a lot done. nothing crazy, just a genuinely solid tuesday.

spent the entire morning deep cleaning my apartment. scrubbed the floors, washed all the bedding, dusted everything. the whole place smells like lemons and fresh laundry now. best feeling in the world tbh.
finally tackled that doom box in the corner of my room that i've been ignoring for months. threw out so much junk and organized the rest. my space feels so much lighter and calmer now.

rearranged the furniture in my living room today just to switch things up. it actually makes the room look so much bigger and gets way more natural light. love doing little free upgrades like this to my space.
got a new set of super soft bamboo sheets and put them on the bed. they feel like absolute heaven. literally counting down the hours until i can go to sleep tonight lol.
watered all my house plants and noticed three of them have new leaves coming in! my monstera is getting massive. taking care of these little green guys brings me way more joy than i ever expected.
ran a hot bath tonight with some epsom salts and eucalyptus oil. played some soft acoustic music and just let all the stress from the week melt away. self care is so incredibly important.
actually managed to sleep for a full nine hours last night without waking up once. i feel like a completely new human being today. crazy how much a good night's sleep changes your entire mood.
turned off my phone for the entire day. no social media, no news, no messages. just read a book, drank some tea, and sat outside. my brain feels so much quieter and peaceful right now.
did a long stretching and yoga session this morning before starting the day. my back finally stopped hurting and i feel so loose and relaxed. definitely going to try and make this a daily habit.
just sitting here realizing that right now, in this exact moment, life is pretty good. got a roof over my head, some good food in the fridge, and my health. feeling really grateful today.
finally fixed the leaky faucet in the bathroom by myself! watched like three youtube tutorials and took a trip to the hardware store but i actually did it. feeling very handy today.
tried some new coffee beans from a local roaster this morning and wow. it has these crazy blueberry notes and it's so smooth. definitely going back to buy a bigger bag.
just found my favorite pair of sunglasses that have been missing since last october! they were wedged deep down inside the lining of my winter coat. absolutely thrilled right now.
hit a new personal record at the gym today on my deadlift. i've been stuck at the same weight for months so breaking past that plateau feels incredible. celebrating with a massive protein shake.
sitting on the balcony watching the sunset and the sky is just insane tonight. bright pinks and purples everywhere. taking a moment just to breathe and take it all in.
my favorite band dropped a new album at midnight and ive just been laying in bed listening to the whole thing with my good headphones. no skips at all, it's a masterpiece.
a random stranger stopped me on the street just to tell me they loved my jacket. honestly such a small thing but it completely made my day and i've been smiling ever since.
just got a fresh haircut after letting it grow out way too long. my head feels ten pounds lighter and the barber actually listened to exactly what i wanted. feeling super confident.
finally put the last piece into this 1000 piece jigsaw puzzle ive been doing for two weeks. it was a picture of a starry night sky and it was so hard. feeling like a genius right now.
just booked flights for a long weekend trip with my best friends! we haven't taken a trip together in years. already making a shared document for all the places we want to eat.
tried that new korean bbq place downtown and it lived up to the hype. the marinated short rib was melting in my mouth. definitely going to be dreaming about that meal.
went thrift shopping and found an absolutely perfect vintage denim jacket for only ten dollars. it fits exactly right and looks like it was made for me. best find of the year hands down.
got a laser pointer for the cat and she has been doing parkour off the living room walls for twenty minutes. i am laughing so hard im crying. the pure joy of simple toys.
did three loads of laundry, folded everything, AND actually put it all away in the drawers. usually it sits in a basket for a week. feeling like a highly functional adult today.
took a different route on my walk today and discovered a beautiful little hidden park with a duck pond. sitting on a bench just feeding the ducks some frozen peas. peaceful vibes.
managed to make the absolute perfect glass of iced coffee at home. exact right ratio of espresso to milk to ice. tasting it actually made me do a little happy dance in the kitchen.
slept in until 10am on a saturday for the first time in months. no alarm, no rushing, just slowly waking up with the sun. best start to a weekend.
finished knitting a scarf that ive been working on intermittently since last winter. it's super chunky and warm, just in time for the cold weather. really proud of the neat edges.
saw a full double rainbow on my drive home from work today after a massive rainstorm. pulled over just to look at it for a few minutes. nature is pretty cool sometimes.
my shy rescue dog finally made a friend at the dog park today! they chased each other around for half an hour and he was wagging his tail the whole time. almost made me tear up.
had a sudden burst of inspiration and spent the last two hours writing a short story. i haven't written creatively in years but the words were just flowing. feels so good to flex that muscle again.
baked a fresh batch of chocolate chip cookies and my entire apartment smells like a bakery. eating them while they are still warm and gooey with a glass of cold milk. pure bliss.
grocery store had a massive sale on my favorite fancy cheese so i bought three blocks. doing a charcuterie board for dinner tonight because why not. treating myself on a tuesday.
spent the evening building a lego set while listening to an audiobook. there is something so satisfying about following the instructions and snapping the little pieces together. great way to unwind.
planted a bunch of herb seeds in little pots on my windowsill. basil, cilantro, and mint. cant wait for them to sprout so i can use them for cooking.
found a box of old home videos in the attic and managed to hook up the old vcr. watched my 5th birthday party and saw all my relatives looking so young. really sweet trip down memory lane.
went for a run and finally hit the 5k mark without having to stop and walk! my lungs are burning but the runner's high is very real right now. super proud of my consistency.
learned a really cool new word today: petrichor. the smell of dust after rain. exactly what it smells like outside right now and i love that there is a specific word for it.
helped my elderly neighbor carry her groceries up the stairs today. she was so sweet and gave me a fresh lemon from her tree as a thank you. just nice to connect with people.
eating a peach that is so perfectly ripe and juicy that i have to stand over the sink. summer fruit is literally the best thing in the world. sticky fingers but totally worth it.
color-coded my entire bookshelf this afternoon. it took way longer than i thought it would but it looks so aesthetically pleasing now. my living room looks like a cool indie bookstore.
finally took my car to get fully detailed inside and out. it smells like new leather and there isn't a single crumb in the cupholders. going to drive around with the windows down just to show off.
listened to a history podcast on my commute today and learned so much about ancient rome. actually made the traffic bearable. love finding new stuff that just captures my attention completely.
made a perfectly curated spotify playlist for my upcoming road trip. tested it out on the drive to the store and every transition is flawless. the vibes are going to be immaculate.
nailed my presentation at work this morning. i was so nervous i was shaking beforehand, but i answered all the questions perfectly and my manager gave me a high five. massive weight off my shoulders.
drew a sketch of my cat sleeping and it actually looks like her! usually my drawings look like potatoes but i think im finally getting the hang of shading. pinning it to my fridge like a proud kid.
started feeding the crows in my backyard unsalted peanuts and today one of them brought me a shiny bottle cap! i have officially made friends with the local corvids. goal unlocked.
put my hand in the pocket of a jacket i haven't worn since last year and found a crisp twenty dollar bill. past me really came through with the unexpected gift. free lunch today!
ordered some new books online and they arrived two days early! the covers are gorgeous and they smell like fresh paper. canceling all my plans tonight to just curl up and read.
tried a new blend of chamomile and lavender tea before bed. it's so incredibly soothing and warming. feeling my eyelids getting heavy already, going to sleep so well tonight.
woke up feeling completely rested, looked at the clock, and realized i still had two hours before my alarm goes off. going back to sleep knowing i have extra time is the ultimate luxury.

bought a huge bouquet of sunflowers at the market just because they looked cheerful. put them in a vase on my kitchen island and they brighten up the entire room. highly recommend buying yourself flowers.
put on my absolute favorite comfort movie, princess bride, and making some stovetop popcorn. i can quote almost every line but it just never gets old. perfectly cozy evening.
friend sent me a meme that was so specifically relatable to my life that i choke-laughed my coffee onto my desk. sent it to my sibling and they had the exact same reaction.
decided to make pancakes, bacon, and eggs for dinner. breakfast for dinner is a top tier meal and nobody can convince me otherwise. pouring maple syrup over everything as we speak.
organized my pantry and put all my dry goods into clear matching containers with little labels. it scratches an itch in my brain i didn't even know i had. standing here just admiring it.
went out to the countryside away from the city lights to go stargazing. the sky is so clear tonight you can actually see the milky way. feeling very small but very peaceful.
got a random text from an old coworker checking in to see how i was doing. we ended up chatting for an hour catching up. really nice to know people are thinking about you.
finally bought the nice pair of walking shoes i've been eyeing for months. took them on a test walk and it feels like im walking on clouds. my feet are going to be so happy.
sitting by the fire pit in the backyard roasting marshmallows. the weather is perfectly crisp and the fire is so warm. just a really solid, quiet end to a good week.

baked a blueberry pie from scratch today! the kitchen smells absolutely heavenly right now. i was worried the crust would be soggy but it turned out perfectly flaky. so excited to cut into this after dinner.
just got my new workout clothes in the mail and they fit so well. the color is this super vibrant teal. it honestly makes me want to go to the gym right now just to show them off.
my cat has been asleep on my lap for over an hour. my leg is completely numb and i really need to go to the bathroom, but it's illegal to move a sleeping cat. im trapped but so happy.

finally figured out how to purl stitch in knitting! i watched like five different tutorials but it finally clicked in my brain today. working on a chunky beanie for winter and it's actually looking like a hat now.
walked along the beach today and found the coolest piece of sea glass. it's perfectly smooth and a deep cobalt blue color. definitely adding it to my little collection on the windowsill.

made the absolute ultimate grilled cheese for lunch. used three different types of cheese and got the bread toasted to the exact right level of golden brown. dipping it in tomato soup makes it an 11/10 meal.
bought a new candle that smells like pine needles and campfire smoke. lighting it makes my tiny apartment feel like a cozy cabin in the woods. honestly such a mood booster on a cloudy day.
went to a retro arcade downtown and spent like twenty bucks in quarters playing ms. pacman and skeeball. i am terrible at all of them but it was so much fun just goofing around like a kid again.

the guy at the local bakery threw in a free chocolate croissant with my morning coffee order just because. such a small random act of kindness but it put a massive smile on my face for the rest of the day.
watched a nature documentary about emperor penguins tonight. they are so goofy and cute when they waddle around. just a super relaxing, wholesome thing to watch before going to sleep.

just bought a loaf of fresh sourdough straight from the oven. it's still warm and the crust crackles when you squeeze it. eating a thick slice with salted butter right now and transcending into another dimension.

spent an hour deep scrubbing the bathroom and now everything is literally sparkling. the shower glass is totally clear and it smells like bleach and lavender. so satisfying to see the before and after.
finally hung up those fairy lights around my bedroom window. turned off the overhead lights and it makes the room look so magical and cozy. perfect vibe for reading in bed tonight.
after being stuck on the same candy crush level for three entire weeks, the stars finally aligned and i beat it. i threw my hands in the air like i just won the olympics. pure relief.
listening to the rain absolutely pouring down against my window right now. i don't have to go anywhere today so im just sitting on the couch wrapped in a fleece blanket. immaculate vibes.

tried out a new local ice cream shop and got their mint chocolate chip. it's the really good kind that is actually white, not dyed green, and has huge chunks of dark chocolate. totally my new favorite spot.

was digging through my childhood boxes and found my old gameboy advance! popped some new batteries in and it still turns on perfectly. currently playing pokemon emerald and feeling intensely nostalgic.

spent the evening painting my nails this really pretty sparkly lavender color. im usually terrible at it but i somehow managed not to get any on my cuticles this time. looking down at my hands and feeling fancy.
found the cutest oversized mug at the thrift store today for fifty cents. it has a little painted duck on it. washing it right now so i can use it for my tea tonight.
successfully parallel parked on a busy street on the very first try today. no reversing back and forth, just swooped right in perfectly. felt like an absolute driving legend.

threw a bunch of random fruit into the blender this morning and accidentally created the best smoothie of my life. mango, banana, and a little bit of ginger. trying to memorize the exact ratios for tomorrow.

saw a tiny dachshund walking down the street wearing a bright yellow raincoat and little boots. i had to stop and physically clutch my chest because it was too cute. made my whole morning commute better.

my bike chain has been squeaking for a week, so i finally watched a youtube tutorial on how to clean and lube it. did it myself in twenty minutes and my ride today was completely silent. feeling very proud.
nothing beats the feeling of sliding into a bed with freshly washed sheets right after taking a hot shower. my legs are so smooth and the bed smells like clean cotton. instant relaxation.
having a freakishly good hair day today for absolutely no reason. my curls are sitting perfectly and have zero frizz. i have no plans but i might go to the grocery store just so someone sees it.

started listening to a comedy podcast my friend recommended and i looked like an idiot laughing out loud by myself on the train today. highly recommend finding something funny to listen to on your commute.
made homemade pizza dough from scratch for the first time. letting it rise right now and it's getting huge! so excited to stretch it out and make margherita pizzas tonight.

was drinking my coffee on the balcony this morning and a monarch butterfly landed right on the railing next to me. it stayed there for a good five minutes just opening and closing its wings. such a beautiful little moment.
just chugged a massive glass of ice water after walking three miles in the heat. why does cold water hit so incredibly hard when you're actually thirsty? best drink on the planet.
bought a super fluffy shag rug for the living room and it just got delivered. unrolled it and instantly laid down on the floor to make carpet angels. my toes are so happy.

tried an iced matcha latte for the first time today. always thought it would taste like grass but it's actually really creamy and slightly sweet. definitely going to be adding this into my coffee shop rotation.

sat down and wrote a long physical letter to my grandmother. no text, just pen and paper. told her about my week and drew some little doodles on the margins. i know she's going to love getting it in the mail.
the barista at the cafe complimented my vintage boots today. it caught me off guard but made me feel so incredibly cool. gonna be riding that high for the rest of the week tbh.
woke up super early today for some reason, so i just made a cup of coffee and watched the sunrise from my window. the sky turned this amazing shade of orange. really peaceful way to start a tuesday.

spent the afternoon being ruthless with my closet. bagged up two huge trash bags of clothes i never wear to drop off at the donation center tomorrow. my closet actually has space in it now and it feels amazing.

finally figured out the perfect coarse grind for my cold brew pitcher. strained it this morning and it's incredibly smooth, zero bitterness. keeping a massive jug in the fridge to save money on cafes.
managed to guess the wordle in only two tries today! my starter word finally paid off. obviously immediately sent my score to the group chat to flex on my friends.
my puppy finally mastered the shake paw trick today! we've been working on it with treats for days and he just handed me his little paw unprompted. hes getting so smart.
picked up a tiny little succulent plant for my work desk today. it's in a cute geometric pot and just adds a nice little pop of green to my workspace. hopefully i don't overwater this one.
just saw the announcement that my favorite sci-fi show is officially getting renewed for a third season! i was so worried it was going to get canceled. doing a little happy dance in my living room.

made the ultimate avocado toast this morning. thick sourdough, perfectly ripe avocado, everything bagel seasoning, and a drizzle of hot honey. tasted like something you'd pay fifteen bucks for at a brunch spot.

went to a roller rink last night for a friend's birthday. haven't skated since i was like ten years old. fell down twice but laughed so hard my ribs hurt. definitely feeling it in my legs today but so worth it.
went out to my tiny garden box and picked my very first ripe cherry tomatoes of the season! they are so red and sweet. eating them like candy straight off the vine.
finally got around to washing and vacuuming my car. it was embarrassingly dirty but now the dashboard is shiny and there's no gravel on the floor mats. feels like im driving a brand new car.

the cashier at the grocery store randomly applied a coupon to my order today and saved me like twelve dollars. people can be so nice for absolutely no reason. paying it forward next time i get a chance.
took a two hour nap on the couch this afternoon with the window open and a gentle breeze coming in. woke up a little disoriented but feeling so refreshed. sunday afternoon naps are top tier.
put on a playlist of hits from the early 2000s while making dinner and i ended up just singing into a wooden spoon for half an hour. totally forgot how much i loved some of these songs.

reached blindly into the chaotic tupperware drawer and pulled out a container and a lid that actually matched perfectly on the very first try. buying a lottery ticket today because my luck is clearly off the charts.
noticed the bananas on my counter were getting super brown and spotty, so i finally got off my butt and baked banana bread. threw some walnuts in there too. my house smells amazing right now.
saw a fat little squirrel sitting on a fence post eating an entire discarded french fry like a harmonica. i stood there and watched him for a solid three minutes. nature is truly beautiful.
just got a new ergonomic desk chair and assembled it myself. my lower back is finally not screaming at me after sitting for hours. honestly the best purchase i've made all year, so worth the money.

making some fresh homemade salsa tonight for taco tuesday. chopped up all the jalapeños, onions, and cilantro right from my little patio garden. the kitchen smells amazing and im ready to eat my weight in tortilla chips.

my favorite indie survival game just released a massive free content update out of nowhere. they added a whole new biome and tons of crafting recipes. well, say goodbye to my weekend plans because i am locking in.

tried a completely new eyeliner technique this morning that i saw on tiktok and my wings are actually perfectly even for once. feeling absolutely fierce today, might take some selfies later just to document this miracle.

hit a new personal best on my run this morning! managed to do a full 5 miles without stopping to walk once. my legs feel like jello right now but i am so incredibly proud of my progress over the last few months.

finally learned how to play the entirety of my favorite song on the keyboard. my hands were shaking by the end of it but i hit every single chord perfectly. such a good feeling to see the practice pay off.

bought a giant watermelon from the farm stand down the road and cracked it open today. it's perfectly crisp, super juicy, and incredibly sweet. honestly sitting outside eating cold watermelon is the absolute best part of summer.
my fluffy orange cat is currently snoring softly directly on my chest. i literally cannot move my arms and i have a ton of chores to do, but i don't even care. this is my life now.
went to the local library today and checked out like six new sci-fi books. it's raining outside so my plan is to bury myself under a pile of fleece blankets on the couch and just read all night long.

my partner completely surprised me with my favorite thai takeout when i got home from a really long, exhausting shift. they even got the extra crispy spring rolls. feeling very loved and appreciated right now.

finally found my missing left airpod! it apparently fell down deep behind the couch cushions like two weeks ago and i thought it was gone forever. so relieved i don't have to spend a hundred bucks to replace it.

just got out of honestly the best shower of my life. the water pressure was perfect, used a really nice smelling eucalyptus soap, and i had a fresh warm towel waiting. feeling so clean and relaxed before bed.

successfully baked a huge batch of cinnamon rolls completely from scratch. the cream cheese icing is literally dripping down the warm sides and my whole house smells like a bakery. definitely eating two of these right now.
saw an incredibly bright, full double rainbow on the drive to work this morning right as the sun was coming up over the hills. i usually hate mornings but that totally started my day off right.

spent the entire afternoon organizing my chaotic digital photo library. deleted thousands of random blurry screenshots and categorized all my vacation pictures into neat little albums. scratches such a deep organizational itch in my brain.

the local independent coffee shop down my street finally brought back my favorite seasonal pumpkin drink today. definitely walking down there tomorrow morning to get a large iced one as a little end-of-the-week treat.

i am officially caught up on all my laundry. every single shirt is washed, folded, and actually put away in the closet instead of sitting in the basket. my room looks so incredibly neat and peaceful right now.

had a very spontaneous game night with my roommates this evening. we played uno and it got ridiculously intense and competitive but we laughed for hours straight. so lucky to live with my best friends.

tried out a new recipe for chicken pad thai and it actually tasted exactly like the version from my favorite restaurant. super proud of myself, definitely adding this into the regular weekly dinner rotation.

woke up naturally exactly five minutes before my alarm was set to go off, feeling completely rested and ready for the day. honestly there is no better feeling than not being jolted awake by that horrible beeping sound.
got my car detailed and washed today and it is literally sparkling in the sun. currently driving it around town playing my favorite playlist with all the windows down. simple things make me so happy.
my little sister just texted me out of nowhere to tell me that im her role model and she looks up to me. i am literally trying so hard not to cry at my desk at work right now.

planted a row of sunflower seeds along the back fence a couple weeks ago and they finally sprouted today! seeing those little green leaves poking through the dirt is so exciting. can't wait until they get super tall.

just randomly discovered a new indie folk band on spotify and their entire discography is an absolute masterpiece. been listening to their albums on repeat all afternoon while working and the vibes are impeccable.
just ate a perfectly ripe, incredibly juicy peach standing right over the kitchen sink. my fingers are totally sticky but it was completely worth it. summer stone fruit is truly top tier food.

was walking past a neighborhood bakery and the smell of fresh sourdough was so good i literally had to go inside and buy a warm loaf. currently tearing off pieces and eating it plain on my walk back home.
my golden retriever was having a dream on the rug and doing those little running kicks and muffled barks in his sleep. it is the cutest thing in the world, i wonder what he's dreaming about chasing.
finally placed the very last piece into a 1000 piece puzzle that has been taking up my entire dining room table for a month. it looks amazing and i finally get my table back for actual meals!
put my hand in the pocket of a thick winter jacket i haven't worn since last year and pulled out a crisp twenty dollar bill! past me really hooked it up. treating myself to a fancy lunch today.

went to a local weekend art market and bought the most beautiful handmade ceramic mug with little blue flowers painted on it. my morning coffee routine is going to be so much more aesthetic from now on.

sitting out on the covered porch just watching a crazy thunderstorm roll through the valley. the lightning is wild and the thunder is literally shaking the house. i absolutely love weather like this, so cozy.

successfully parallel parked my car on the very first try on a super busy downtown street with a bunch of people sitting at a cafe watching me. felt like an absolute superhero stepping out of the car.

bought a bunch of cheap blank canvas boards and just went crazy making abstract shapes with some acrylic paints. it probably looks like a mess to anyone else but the process was so therapeutic and fun.
my favorite true crime podcast just dropped a surprise two-hour bonus episode today out of nowhere! definitely going to make my boring hour-long commute this evening actually enjoyable for once.
just cooked up a massive bowl of creamy stovetop mac and cheese and it hit the absolute spot after a long day. sometimes you just need some heavy carbs and dairy to make everything feel okay.

saw a really beautiful, huge luna moth resting on my window screen tonight. managed to sneak up and take some macro photos of it on my phone, the green color and patterns are just stunning to look at.
all of my indoor houseplants are absolutely thriving right now. my neon pothos has grown long vines down the entire side of my bookshelf this summer. having greenery inside really boosts my mood.
finally tried that new boba shop that opened up downtown and their brown sugar milk tea is insanely good. the boba pearls were so soft and warm. definitely adding this place to my regular rotation.
